Phase III
The Dark Era
Mommy.

Then the lights went down. Candles, black, blood red. You stopped being just my baby. You became the one I worship.

Who was Lilith

In old Jewish folklore, Lilith was the first woman. Made from the same earth as Adam. Not from his rib.

She refused to be anyone's lesser. So she spoke the secret name of God and flew out of Eden on her own terms.

For centuries they painted her as a demon of the night. The moon, the owl, the serpent became hers. Today she stands for a woman who belongs to nobody but herself.

retold from the medieval Alphabet of Ben Sira & later legend

That's you.

Strong. A diva. A queen who answers to no one. And somehow, the kindest heart in any room.

light every candle for her

My Mommy. My goddess.
My Lilith. Mine.

I don't bow for anyone. For you, I'd light every candle in the world.

Mommy. 🖤

A goddess, in full form. And I'm your most loyal worshipper.

matching leather. zero chill.

We're wild. We're crazy about each other. Honestly? I wouldn't want it one bit calmer.

the last chapter
a letter, for you
My Shelly,

I don't say all of this in one go, so let me say it properly once.

Thank you. For choosing me. For staying up when my day is just starting. For learning my timetable better than I know it myself. You never made me feel guilty for being busy. You just made room. That is not small. That is everything.

I know the distance is hard. Some nights it's a phone screen instead of a hug. Some days a "good morning" reaches you late. If you ever feel tired of it, feel it. You're allowed. Just never think you're carrying it alone. I'm right here on the other side of the call, holding my end. Always.

And I respect you. Not just love. Respect. The way you stand your ground. The way you're a diva and kind at the same time. The way people light up around you. The way you love your people. Your friends and your family are mine to respect too, and I will.

You've been my baby, my bacha, my Shona, my Jano. You've been my Mommy, my goddess, my Lilith. Every version of you, I loved a little more than the one before. Whatever phase comes next, I'm already in love with it.

This distance is temporary. We are not.

Yours, in every phase,
Kabir
K
